requiredBusinessCapabilities.name: Default Base Currency Flag
requiredBusinessCapabilities.description: System must track which currency is the primary accounting base currency.

requiredBusinessCapabilities.name: Single Base Currency Invariant
requiredBusinessCapabilities.description: Accounting invariant: exactly one currency in 0_currencies must have is_default = 1.

requiredBusinessCapabilities.name: Prevent Base Currency Archival
requiredBusinessCapabilities.description: Statutory guard: system must block archival or deletion of the base currency.

requiredBusinessCapabilities.name: Atomic Base Currency Switch
requiredBusinessCapabilities.description: Changing default base currency must execute in a DB transaction clearing previous default.

requiredBusinessCapabilities.name: Base Currency Rate Enforcement
requiredBusinessCapabilities.description: The base currency exchange rate must always equal 1.0.
